mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.5 percentage points over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals worsening labor market conditions that trigger a flight to quality and defensive sectors, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession fears intensify.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 0.5% over 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.01 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as manufacturing slowdowns signal weakening economic activity, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO declines by more than 0.5% over 3 months, or the Rank IC is negative over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates strengthening consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS rises by at least 0.5% over 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC is negative over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in employment (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates a severe labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS declines > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.3 percentage points and PAYEMS declines by more than 0.5% over 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.01 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a housing market recovery (HOUST rising above 1300 thousand units), S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 5 trading days as housing sector strength boosts consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST exceeds 1300 thousand units for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 2-year rolling window.
